description: Synthetic dialogue profile for the generated 20-frame rapid-dialogue replay clip testdata/synthetic/replay/catch-up-001 (issue #25, ADR-0122; docs/spec/11 'Fixture origins'). The four real lines are the clip's invented sentences, four boxes from two speakers; the rest are invented distractors so ranking a half-revealed line is a real decision (docs/spec/05 'Short strings and overlapping prefixes require more evidence'). No real game text. The speaker attribution is deliberately NOT here: it lives in the scenario (testdata/scenarios/synthetic/gn-t025-catch-up.yaml), because a profile has no speaker column and the synthetic scenario declares it.

messages.original_text: The bell rang twice before the fog lifted off the quay.
Nobody in the village had seen a boat like that before.
The harbourmaster will want to hear what we saw tonight.
Then we row out before the tide turns against us.
The harbour bell was silent when the last ship left.
Fog rolled in from the open water by midday.
The village kept its distance from the old breakwater.
A stranger's hull sat low in the channel at dawn.
The harbourmaster logged the weather in a red book.
We counted the lanterns along the mole before dark.
The tide gave us a wide margin to cross the bar.
Rowing home we let the current carry the boat.
The quay was empty but for the gulls at first light.
Somebody had left a rope coil by the mooring ring.
